highlights.title: Browse an agent's files
highlights.line: An agent's Files screen lists its folders and files, previews images and text, and downloads a folder as one zip.

highlights.title: A team map for each project
highlights.line: A project's Team map, on its Members card or above its Agents list, shows who reports to whom, what each holds and who handed work on.

highlights.title: Agents are told how to finish a task
highlights.line: An agent that reports on a task it holds, with kosmos task message, is now told how to mark that task done.

highlights.title: See which agent changed a file
highlights.line: A project's Files page usually shows which Claude agent changed a file last.

highlights.title: A paused room says why
highlights.line: When Kosmos pauses a room whose agents kept going back and forth, a note above the message box says why and offers Reopen.
